mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy with increased demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts and low unemployment, or the correlation between housing starts and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which leads to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with easing monetary policy, or the correlation between monetary policy and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong labor market, or the correlation between labor market and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index indicates decreased demand for goods and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances with low consumer price index, or the correlation between consumer price index and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).
